Common Questions

How do I book?

Tap any “Book on WhatsApp” button. A message with your chosen duration and fee opens in WhatsApp for you to send.

Are consultations in person?

Consultations are conducted over a call.

How can I join the astrology course?

Use “Enquire on WhatsApp” in the Academy section to ask for the syllabus, batch information and enrollment details.
